text:
Maya R: Morning team — I’ve got a dentist appointment and will be offline 08:45–10:15. Can someone pick up primary from 08:30 until I’m back? I’ll stay reachable on phone for critical pages. @Dan H @Liam S :hand:

Oncall Bot: Rotation status — current primary: Maya R, secondary: Liam S. To claim primary, run: `claim-oncall --role primary --until 2026-03-15T10:30Z`. (link: https://redwood.internal/ops/oncall)

Dan H: I can take primary 08:30–10:30. Will monitor pages and escalate if anything spikes.

Liam S: I’ll be secondary and standby. Can we confirm there aren’t any scheduled canaries or deploys 09:00–10:00? I’m juggling a CI run.

Maya R: There’s a small canary for model-x at 09:05 but it’s low risk — infra told me it’s a config tweak. I marked it in the handoff doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/handovers/1902345678

Incident Bot: Page routed to primary at 09:03 — alert: model-serving-err 503 (rate-limited). Incidents channel: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-217

Dan H: Picking up that 503 now. Quick triage: logs show KV cache eviction storm. Trying warm caches on pool-a. If it persists, fallback to model-v2 under routing policy. I'll update here.

Liam S: If you need me to flip routing, I can run the plan: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/routes/fallback -d '{"route":"model-v2"}'` — but prefer to wait for Dan's check.

Dan H: Warmed cache, error rate dropping. Will follow for 10m. Leaving notes in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-eviction — steps 2b/3

Maya R: Awesome, thank you both. I’ll hand back primary when I’m back online. Leaving my phone number in case: +1-555-810-2026.

Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded: primary transferred Maya R -> Dan H (08:30–10:30). Coverage note: canary at 09:05, incident at 09:03 (resolved). Handoff ID: HND-1902345678

Dan H: Acknowledged. I’ll also add a short postmortem note if anything recurs.

Maya R: Back now at 10:18, taking primary. Thanks for the cover. :pray:

Dan H: Welcome back — I’ll hand control over. Notes: cache eviction resolved, will watch for 30m for regressions.

Liam S: Thx — closing my secondary standby. :white_check_mark:
